# AMEVA-Forge Full Technical Specification (v1.0.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Browser-Native WebGPU Deep Learning Tensor & Autograd Engine with PyTorch Syntax
Compiles autograd graphs directly to WGSL WebGPU shaders, executing entirely on client GPU with zero server egress.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: ameva
- Command: pip install ameva
# or CDN:
<script src="https://uno-km.github.io/uno-km/lib/forge/ameva.js"></script>
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/AMEVA-Forge
